title: How to Understand What Black Holes Look Like
summary: Veritasium explains what a black hole should look like, using J.P. Luminet's 1979 work and a cardboard 3D model to show how light bends around it. It was made just as the first black hole image was released.
why: Recommended for correctly predicting the features of the real black hole image and clearly explaining the lensing physics behind it.

quote.text: Good video that correctly predicted the image and describes why it looks the way it does
